notes.title: Drops of Death is out now! 💀🩸
notes.content:
[h2]💀🩸Happy Launch Day! 🩸💀[/h2][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618055/d710ff6004cca76a9ede45e0ac25d350e27a84de.png"][/img]
Our killer dating sim is available now. Enjoy our special launch discount~

[b]✨Things you should know ✨[/b][/h3][h3][b]

🎙️There's partial voice acting! 🎙️[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Check out our latest trailer featuring our fantastic cast. [/p][previewyoutube="W21OYQiAlEk;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][b]🔓Unlockable Killer Select Feature 🔪[/b][/h3][p][b]
[/b]After completing your first full playthrough, you can unlock a feature that lets you preselect the killer, or you can choose to keep it randomized.[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618055/ecf13ce7c91910915f1789b2e3dd057d43a30152.png"][/img]
[b]✨There are over 50 possible endings. ✨[/b][/h3][p][b]
[/b]For your first complete playthrough of the game, you can expect 2-3 hours of playtime, varying depending on the choices you make and the killer that was selected. You can expect 15-20 hours of playtime to complete the entire game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618055/096b024cb5b71fa041cf70c0bcc0a2bd895ee530.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]🔍Collect evidence to the crime🔍[/b][/h3][p]Play all routes to collect all of the different pieces of evidence.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618055/1be27f6e8e14e4af145852c032b910e841704d0a.png"][/img][/p][h2]
[b]Are you ready to fall in love with these killers? 💀💔
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618055/2975d626c33928e717f2fdb9a9486c5563147439.png"][/img][/h2][p]
Thank you all for your support. We hope you love our game. Kindly leave us a review and let us know <3

- Snowhaven Studios[/p]
